title: Pro-Palestine protesters block Oxford Circus and Piccadilly Circus in London
seoTitle: London pro-Palestine protest at Oxford Circus

tea.why: Protesters rallied against Israeli military action in Gaza and the West Bank, and continued Israeli strikes despite a ceasefire.
tea.want: Demonstrators called for an end to the occupation, to stop arming Israel, and for the closure of Elbit Systems' UK operations.
tea.changed: Oct 3: Protesters blocked traffic at Oxford Circus and Piccadilly Circus in London.

summary: A pro-Palestine demonstration took place in central London on a Saturday night, bringing traffic to a standstill at Oxford Circus and Piccadilly Circus, according to sources [1, 2]. Protesters waved Palestinian and Iraqi flags, chanted "Free, free Palestine," and called for "No justice, no peace" [2]. The demonstration was held to protest Israeli military actions in Gaza and the West Bank, as well as continued Israeli strikes despite a ceasefire [1, 2]. Demands included stopping the arming of Israel, removing Palantir from the NHS, ending the occupation, and closing Elbit Systems' operations in Britain [2].
demands: Closure of Elbit Systems' operations in Britain
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: A pro-Palestine demonstration blocked traffic at Oxford Circus and Piccadilly Circus in central London, protesting Israeli military actions.
